mapper.select: SELECT id, username, phone, gender, member_level AS memberLevel, total_spent AS totalSpent, balance, member_card_no AS memberCardNo, status, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime, role_id AS roleId, avatar FROM user WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET username = #{username}, phone = #{phone}, gender = #{gender}, avatar = #{avatar}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE user SET avatar = #{avatar}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
